from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its title and case type as stated in the text."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title or identifier")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The stated case type/case cause (案由) as written in the document")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broader legal category: civil/刑事/行政, etc.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
